name: dbu-security-system
description: DBU Security Guard & Gate Asset Management System

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: './backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: './frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
